market_question: Will Eleni Kounalakis win the California Governor Election in 2026?
reasoning: The market assigns a near-zero chance to Kounalakis, but she is an early frontrunner in a wide-open Democratic primary. As a Democrat in deep-blue California, winning the primary all but guarantees the governorship. Early polling shows her leading a splintered field, making a 5% probability far more realistic than the 0.2% implied by the market price.
evidence_points: Berkeley IGS poll (Jan 2024) showed Kounalakis leading the Dem primary with 11%, ahead of Villaraigosa (9%) and others, in a field with 40% undecided.
Eleni Kounalakis has held statewide office as Lieutenant Governor since 2019, giving her significant name recognition and donor networks.
California is solidly Democratic; no Republican has won a statewide race since 2006, so the primary winner is an overwhelming favorite in the general election.
sources_consulted: Berkeley IGS Poll (Jan 2024) on 2026 CA Governor primary
